paper_title: Search for light scalar Dark Matter candidate with AURIGA detector
coupling_convention: dimensionless d_e (equivalently d_me; paper constrains d_i = dme + de assuming one coupling dominates)
notes: AURIGA resonant-mass detector search for scalar (moduli) dark matter. Paper sets 95% C.L. upper limits d_i <~ 1e-5 on the coupling of moduli to ordinary matter over the sensitive band Delta_f = [850, 950] Hz (masses ~3.52e-12 to 3.93e-12 eV, using m = 4.136e-15 * f). The limit applies identically to the electromagnetic gauge modulus coupling d_e (ScalarPhoton) and the electron-mass modulus coupling d_me (ScalarElectron) since the observable depends on dme + de; ScalarPhoton chosen per pre-analysis hint, but ScalarElectron is equally valid, hence confidence capped at 0.5. Exact frequency-dependent limit curve is only in Fig. 5 (not numerically available); emitted points are the text-quoted flat ~1e-5 level across the band.
